title: Account & System Settings
subtitle: Manage school profile, administrator access, and payment gateway options.
stripeDescription: Enable or disable live Stripe card checkout on the public landing page.
stripeDisabledTitle: Stripe Gateway is DISABLED (Cash / In-School Mode)
stripeLiveDesc: Customers can pay online via Credit/Debit card with instant webhook confirmation.
stripeDisabledDesc: Checkout creates reservations with 'Pay at school' (Cash/POS) without requiring credit cards.
subscriptionsDescription: Allow clients to enroll in courses with recurring monthly billing in addition to one-off full payment.
subscriptionsLiveDesc: Clients can choose between full upfront payment or monthly installments on checkout.
subscriptionsDisabledDesc: Clients can only enroll by paying the full tuition upfront in a single transaction.
changePasswordDesc: Update your password to keep your account secure.
deleteAccountDesc: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.
